description: This file is a Next.js page component implementing user authentication with SuperTokens, including server-side session handling, and client-side UI for sign out and fetching user data.

methods.name: getServerSideProps
methods.description: Fetches user session on server side, handles token refresh or unauthorized errors, and passes userId as prop.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main React component rendering the authenticated page with sign out and fetch user data functionalities.

methods.name: logoutClicked
methods.description: Handles user sign out and redirects to authentication page.

methods.name: fetchUserData
methods.description: Fetches user data from API endpoint, redirects to auth if unauthorized, or alerts user data.
